chicago-roads.description: OpenStreetMap driveable street network clipped to the City of Chicago, simplified (degree-2 nodes merged), largest strongly connected component. Directed edges, CSR-sorted by source.
storyNotes: 29,557 intersections and 77,140 directed edges (27,799 two-way street pairs plus 21,542 one-way edges); 10,323 directed km of road in the largest strongly connected component.
Directed km by class: motorway 432, trunk 38, primary 230, secondary 1,686, tertiary 1,298, residential 6,478, service/other 161.
The Chicago grid shows: 4,541 four-way intersections (15% of nodes with 4 out-edges).
Expressways (I-90/94 Dan Ryan and Kennedy, I-55 Stevenson, I-290 Eisenhower) are modelled as motorway edges and are the fast corridors for isochrones.
Median edge length 102 m, longest 5,049 m.

chicago-places.description: Overture Maps Foundation places (release 2026-09-23.1) inside the City of Chicago, open, confidence >= 0.5, mapped to 14 broad categories from Overture taxonomy.
chicago-places.license: Overture Places: CDLA-Permissive-2.0 (most sources), Apache-2.0 (Foursquare), CC0 (AllThePlaces) per docs.overturemaps.org/attribution/places
storyNotes: 105,808 open places; by category: finance_business 38,117, health 12,403, restaurant_cafe 11,585, retail 10,308, worship_community 7,027, personal_services 6,664, other 5,295, arts_culture 3,315.
1,255 grocery/convenience places vs 11,585 restaurants/cafes: food-access (food desert) stories by tract.
240 transit-tagged places (bus/train stations) are noisy relative to the CTA GTFS; treat as a proxy.
Places are denser downtown and along commercial corridors: strong spatial clustering for Ripley K / cross-K.
Overture merges several commercial sources, so POI counts follow business-data coverage, not ground truth: weak in some South/West side tracts.

source.selection: 2048 systematic spatial-order proposals across full extent; boundary replacements from complementary systematic sample

conventions:
Shapely STRtree nearest-edge reference on f32 planar endpoint chords.

Chicago: full 77,140 directed roads, all 29,557 original nodes, 2,048 reproducible
spatially ordered/systematically sampled places from the full 105,808-row input.
WGS84 -> local AEQD (41.885,-87.635), then float32; no geographic-mode claim.
Preserve CSR edge-row -> original source-edge mapping. Travel-time weights are
unmodified f32 seconds. Reference geometry is Shapely query_nearest,
line_locate_point and line_interpolate_point, on the actual rounded coordinates.
For real data retain exact nearest tie sets and every candidate within twice the
G-profile coordinate bound of the minimum. Reciprocal edges can round differently
on GPU: accept only this explicitly enumerated uncertainty interval and compare
ALL numeric outputs to the independent projection on the selected edge. No global
ID tolerance. Synthetic axis-aligned ties require the documented smallest CSR ID.

G bound: 16 ulps at maximum coordinate magnitude covers subtraction, projection
and interpolation; fraction bound = coordinate bound / edge length plus 8 f32
epsilons; weighted cost bound = fraction bound * edge weight + 8 weight ulps.
No relative tolerance is added. Synthetic exact threshold includes distance=2 and
just-outside=2.25. Real queries within one coordinate bound of radius=50m are
excluded before selection and counted. Candidate capacity bounds ALL expanded
query-square/edge-envelope intersections with STRtree (plus margin), not only
nearest winners; GPU must report zero overflow. Synthetic scans and BVH run with
both default geometric costs and explicit costs, all three start directions.
